description: This file defines a Kotlin object 'NetworkConfig' that manages and provides the backend base URL for network requests. It centralizes URL configuration, ensuring a trailing slash, and defaults to a preset URL if none is configured, based on BuildConfig.API_BASE_URL.

classes.name: NetworkConfig
classes.description: A singleton object that manages the backend base URL, ensuring it is properly formatted with a trailing slash and falls back to a default URL if not configured.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the backend base URL, using the configured value if available, or defaulting to a preset URL, ensuring a trailing slash.
